meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 9 (DECISIONS 031, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new models, 15 quotes. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{mac-studio,ult-wear,pulse-explore,wave-keys,sport-open-earbuds}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~18:10-18:25 UTC (10:10-10:25 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) The current Mac Studio is the M5 Max generation (announced 2026-08-25, available 2026-09-22), NOT the 2025 M4 Max — the M4 Max MU963LL/A launched at $1,999 and is discontinued per EveryMac, and the feed's Apple row pairing MU963LL/A with $2,499 mixes the old MPN with the new price and was excluded; the base M5 Max is MHL64LL/A, $2,499. (2) The ULT WEAR candidate price $249.99 is the list price; the current street price is $148.00 at Best Buy, Crutchfield and BuyDig (Black Friday deal; Best Buy deal ends Nov 8). (3) The PULSE Explore candidate price $149 is $149.99, a sale price off the $199.99 list. (4) The Wave Keys candidate price $69.99 is confirmed current (the 2023 launch price was $59.99 per Logitech's blog). (5) The Bose Sport Open Earbuds are a NEW 2026 product (announced 2026-09-17, available 2026-10-01), not the 2021 original — the 2021 Sport Open Earbuds 857628-0010 (UPC 017817826211) are a different in-ear product and were excluded. Two direct prices are price-only (stock not confirmed in the page text): Apple direct Mac Studio $2,499.00 (JSON-LD price; stock confirmed separately by B&H InStock + Best Buy) and the Bose direct price was not shown in the bose.com page text at all this batch. Excluded as captured: marketplace/third-party rows (DECISIONS 021) — Mac Studio M1/M2/M4 marketplace rows ($2,099-$2,999), ULT WEAR $25 copy row and $349.99 marketplace row, Wave Keys $127.20 marketplace row; non-US rows — ULT WEAR Coolblue NL $106, PULSE Explore UK barcode 711719590231, Wave Keys AU Graphite 920-012281, Mac Studio UK MHL64B/A / AU MHL64X/A UPCs; bundles — ULT WEAR headphone+adapter/stand/warranty bundles ($169.99-$386), Target gSport case bundle ($249.99), Bose Best Buy charger bundle ($202.99); different variants — M5 Ultra Mac Studio (from $5,499, MHL74LL/A), 40-core GPU Mac Studio tiers (48GB/1TB $3,399 Z1U4000E9), M4 Max / M3 Ultra / M2 Max / M2 Ultra Mac Studios, ULT WEAR White (UPC 027242929449), PULSE Explore White, PULSE Elite headset (1000044173), PULSE 3D headset (CFI-ZWH1), Wave Keys MK670 combo 920-012059 ($89.99), Wave Keys for Business 920-012058 ($76.99-$139.99), Wave Keys for Mac 920-012402, Wave Keys Sand 920-013925 2026 refresh (B&H $69.99, Staples $77.27), Wave Keys + Lift combos ($119.99), Wave Keys Rose / Off-White (Off-White is 920-012275), US International layout 920-012304, Bose Sport Open Earbuds Eucalyptus Green 901149-0030 / White Smoke 901149-0020, Bose Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen ($299), Bose QC Earbuds; accessories — PULSE Explore PlayStation Link USB adapter ($24.99-$30), ULT WEAR headphone stands.
